method: OpenStreetMap way 1504181774 (office=research, short_name='БНО', start_date=1973), taken verbatim.
name: Baksan Neutrino Observatory administrative building (surface)
notes: This is the surface administrative building near the tunnel portal, not the SAGE underground laboratory 3.5 km inside the mountain (site:baksan-sage-underground-lab is unlocated on this map; see map.unlocated and the facility worklog). The SAGE collaboration's own paper (src:sage-1999-capture-rate) describes 'a general laboratory building outside the adit' housing subsidiary facilities, which this OSM feature plausibly depicts, though no fetched source names it explicitly as that building.

summary.plain: The Baksan Neutrino Observatory's surface administrative building, near the entrance to the tunnels under Mount Andyrchi.
